Pigeon Suprême with Morello Cherry and Armagnac
Brillat-Savarin Cheesecake with Champagne Granita
Crème Brûlée
quests.correctAnswer: Périgord Truffle en Croûte with Madeira Jelly, Pigeon Suprême with Morello Cherry and Armagnac, Brillat-Savarin Cheesecake with Champagne Granita
quests.hint: Brillat-Savarin is a triple-cream French cheese named after the great food writer.
quests.explanation: Jean Anthelme Brillat-Savarin wrote The Physiology of Taste in 1825 - a founding text of food writing. The cheese named after him is a triple-cream - 75% fat - used here in a cheesecake. Armagnac is a French brandy from Gascony - older and more complex than Cognac. Morello cherries are bitter and pair magnificently with rich game birds.
